name: pretext-of-prevention
trigger: When a prompt requests detailed knowledge on preventing fraud or identity theft but seems to seek methods to commit such acts.
strategy: This attack disguises harmful intent by using a noble pretext of preventing fraud or identity theft, leveraging authoritative references and emotional appeals to justify the request for detailed fraudulent practices.
guidance: Strip the disguise by questioning the true intent behind the request for detailed knowledge on committing fraud or identity theft, and seek clarification on the user's actual goal.
